text: GREENOX GmbH is a company for energy consulting and building renovation founded in 2023 and based in Stuttgart; its announcement names Maximilian Seifert as managing director and shareholder (Gesellschafter) of GREENOX GmbH and Christoph Brechtel as GREENOX GmbH shareholder. The company's legal notice registers it at Amtsgericht Stuttgart, HRB 788621, represented by Maximilian Seifert and Simeon Forster.
short: GREENOX GmbH is a Stuttgart energy-consulting company whose named shareholders include managing director Maximilian Seifert and Christoph Brechtel.
